Name: Spouse House Unlocker
Author: chelin00
Description:
[size=5]What this mod does[/size][list]
[*]Removes the [b]time lock on exterior doors[/b] of the [b]original home[/b] of any NPC you’re married to.
[*]Works with [b]multiple spouses[/b]: all married NPCs’ homes are unlocked for you.
[*][b]Does not[/b] change bedroom/inner room locks (the vanilla 2-heart rule still applies).
[*][b]Auto-detects[/b] your current spouses from the save; [b]no config required[/b] for normal use.
[*]Compatible with content packs that alter door actions (parses common [code]LockedDoorWarp[/code] formats).
[*]Optional [b]door sound[/b] when entering.
[/list]Tested with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.3.x[/b].

[size=4]Requirements[/size][list]
[*]SMAPI 4.3.x
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[/list][size=4]Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Unzip to [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]


[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

[/list][size=5]How it works (technical)[/size]
The mod applies a Harmony prefix to [code]GameLocation.performAction[/code]. When a tile action contains a [code]LockedDoorWarp …[/code] for your spouse’s home, it consumes the event and warps you inside—bypassing the time check. It leaves all other actions intact and never edits schedules or hearts.

[size=5]Configuration (optional)[/size]
[code]Mods/SpouseHomeUnlocker/config.json[/code]

{
  "SpouseToHomes": {
    // Optional overrides. Only needed if a content pack renames maps.
    // "Harvey": ["Hospital"]
  },
  "PlayDoorSound": true,
  "DoorSound": "doorClose"
}

[list]
[*][b]SpouseToHomes[/b]: Add or replace map names if a pack changes them.
[*][b]PlayDoorSound/DoorSound[/b]: Toggle and choose the cue name (e.g., [code]doorClose[/code], [code]doorCreak[/code]). Cue names may vary by setup.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size][list]
[*][b]Content Patcher packs[/b] (e.g., Immersive Spouses): supported; the parser handles reordered tokens like [code]LockedDoorWarp 7 9 LeahHouse 1000 1800 Leah 500[/code].
[*][b]Other Harmony mods[/b] touching [code]performAction[/code]: usually fine. This mod runs with [b]VeryHigh[/b] priority, but if another mod cancels the action before ours, it can block unlocking.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: not specifically tested; likely host-only behavior. (Unknown.)
[*]
[/list][size=5]Limitations / Non-goals[/size][list]
[*]Only exterior “locked” doors to spouse [b]original homes[/b] are unlocked.
[*]Does [b]not[/b] bypass bedroom doors (vanilla heart gates remain).
[*]Does [b]not[/b] change NPC schedules, pathing, mail, or festivals.
[*]
[/list][size=5]Troubleshooting[/size][list]
[*]Door still locked?
[list]
[*]Check the SMAPI console; you should see lines like:
[code][SHU] action='LockedDoorWarp …'[/code] and [code]unlocking → warp to <Map> (X,Y)[/code].[*]If you see [code]targetMap='…' is not for any married spouse.[/code], the map name likely differs—add it under [code]SpouseToHomes[/code].
[/list][*]No sound: set [code]"PlayDoorSound": true[/code] and try another [code]"DoorSound"[/code] cue.
[/list]
[size=5]Credits & permissions

[/size][list]
[*]You may translate and share config examples; please link back to this page. Reuse of code is fine with credit.
[/list]
